ai_overview.answer_markdown:
If you're looking for **smart lock installation in Essendon, VIC**, here are some well-reviewed local options:

- TLC Security Locksmiths – Based in Essendon, they supply and install a wide range of smart locks including Yale, Schlage, Kaadas, Samsung, Eufy, August, and others. They also install customer-supplied smart locks if you've already purchased one. Their website showcases many recent smart lock installations. [www.tlcsecurity.com.au](https://www.tlcsecurity.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- Essendon Locksmith Vic – 24/7 locksmith service covering smart lock installations and security upgrades.
- Keyvale Locksmiths – Local locksmith servicing Essendon North and surrounding suburbs.
- Human Key Locksmiths – Nearby mobile locksmith with extensive residential lock installation experience.

If you haven't purchased a smart lock yet, a locksmith can usually recommend a model that suits your door type. Common options include:
- Yale Assure/Unity
- Schlage Encode
- Eufy Smart Lock series
- Kaadas biometric locks
- Lockwood smart locks

Typical installation costs in Melbourne are approximately:
- **Installation only (customer-supplied lock):** A$150–A$300
- **Supply and installation:** A$400–A$900+, depending on the lock and whether door modifications are required. Community reports suggest installation-only pricing often falls around A$150–A$200 for straightforward jobs. [www.reddit.com](https://www.reddit.com/r/AusRenovation/comments/1k6kchh?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

If you tell me:
- the **type of door** (timber, aluminium, security screen, etc.), and
- whether you **already have a smart lock** or need one supplied,

I can recommend the most compatible lock and give you a more accurate estimate.
